name: JS1/flashcards
top_fix: Rewrite 05-PRACTICE.md exercises 1-4 so the whole body is about decks/cards (currently ~95% identical to budget-tracker's), and delete the false PostgreSQL-18.1 environment sentence from VERIFICATION.md.
summary: Real state-machine fix: study sessions snapshot card ids, require a reveal before grading, complete explicitly, and roll back the cursor when localStorage.setItem throws. Excerpt matches app.js:243 verbatim; 2 tests with ~14 assertions plus a genuine Playwright reload check. Off the target stacks (no HTTP/SQL/React) and ~63% of the course is shared template.

name: JS1/habit-tracker
top_fix: Add a test that seeds two habits, calls render(), and asserts the TEXT of each .best-streak badge -- bestStreak is currently only called directly via app.evaluate(), so npm test never proves the UI wiring.
summary: Best small date-logic exercise in the batch: currentStreak can now anchor on yesterday, and a new bestStreak rejects non-true values, impossible dates (2024-02-30) and future entries via an ISO round-trip. One fixture exercises leap day, a gap, a false, an impossible date and a future date at once. Browser-only; ~65% shared template; VERIFICATION claims a PostgreSQL environment never used here.

name: JS1/reading-list
top_fix: Add tests for the title/status id tie-break on app.js:145 (delivered untested) and coerce ids with String(a.id).localeCompare(String(b.id)) so legacy numeric ids do not throw.
summary: Thinnest course in B02. Status filter composes with search, sorting becomes total (rating then title then id), and a summary separates visible count from overall finished count -- all correct, but shipped with a single test that skips the tie-break branch it just added. Lowest specificity in the batch (33% unique words); 06-SOLUTIONS repeats one identical review paragraph under all four exercises.

name: JS1/note-vault
top_fix: Pin the toolchain: all seven package.json dependencies are "latest" with no package-lock.json, so the npm install / npm run build the course instructs is not reproducible.
summary: Substantial, honest delivery. Extracts a JSON repository, serializes every read-modify-write through one promise queue, replaces whole-file writes with temp+rename, bounds request bodies, makes the Express app exportable for real-HTTP tests, and fixes a client that never mounted (index.html pointed at App.jsx with no createRoot). Best failure test in the batch: injects a failing rename, asserts byte-identical file contents, then asserts the repo refuses to reseed over corrupt data.

name: JS1/budget-tracker
top_fix: Normalize legacy stored amounts on load: renderTransactions rounds amount*100 for display but storage keeps the extra digits, so rows and totals can disagree for records saved by the old build.
summary: Tight drill on money handling. parseCents replaces Number() and is asserted to reject '', '0', '-1', '1.001', 'Infinity', '1e3' and out-of-range values; totals accumulate in integer cents so 0.1 + 0.2 renders $0.30; create/edit/delete publish only after localStorage.setItem succeeds, with the form retained on failure. Browser-only and ~67% shared template.

name: JS1/pantry-inventory
top_fix: Add a test for the visibilitychange handler (app.js:183) -- the advertised 'returning to the tab refreshes date-based status' behavior has zero automated coverage; the Chromium check calls renderItems() directly instead.
summary: Good modelling lesson: the original code called a fully-stocked expired item 'Fresh' because low-stock and expiry were one status field. The fix makes them independent predicates with an Expired filter, uses local-date construction rather than toISOString, and rejects blank quantities (Number('') is 0) and impossible dates. Sloppy index.html option/select edit; browser-only; ~65% shared template.

name: JS1/snippet-vault
top_fix: Fix the mojibake at src/store.js:1 ('// store.js â€” owns the data...') -- UTF-8 re-encoded as cp1252 during delivery; the only such file in B02, and its corrupted bytes were confirmed rather than caught by the delivery hash check.
summary: Store now publishes state only after localStorage.setItem succeeds, throws on blank content and on a missing edit id, dedupes tags case-insensitively, and copyToClipboard returns false on permission denial instead of leaving an unhandled rejection. Clever test fixture (cache-busting dynamic import for fresh module state). Two defects: the line-1 encoding corruption, and bare catch {} in main.js collapsing two distinct user-readable errors into one generic message.

name: JS1/room-booking
top_fix: Add a 00-PREREQS.md covering tstzrange, EXCLUDE USING gist, why btree_gist is needed for the room_id = operand, and DST-variable day length -- 02-CONCEPTS.md assumes all of it from its first sentence.
summary: The most job-like project in B02 and the only one where a database constraint, not application code, is the arbiter. Test races two identical POSTs and asserts [201,409], books the adjacent slot successfully (half-open intervals), and after a 409 on PUT re-reads ends_at from SQL to prove the row is unchanged. Adds validation.ts (UUID/real-date/ISO-with-offset/bounded text), browser-local day windows, and real UI editing. Hardest course here; devDependencies are all "latest" with no lockfile.

name: newcodexJS/04-notes-app
top_fix: Split server/test/search.test.cjs into four named test() blocks -- VERIFICATION reports 'Automated test cases: 1' for a block holding ~16 assertions, which makes the best-covered change in the batch look like the least-covered.
summary: Best pure-CRUD-API course in B02. Replaces whereRaw("CAST(notes AS TEXT) ILIKE ?") -- which matched ids, timestamps and folder names and let user '%' act as a wildcard -- with a parameterised to_tsvector/plainto_tsquery predicate over title+body, fixes PUT so omitted fields survive, bounds all payloads/filters, and adds a debounced client search with a request-version guard proven in Chromium against a deliberately delayed response. No GIN index yet (disclosed).

name: newcodexJS/06-bookmark-manager
top_fix: Fix server/src/models/model.ts listRecords, which still runs CAST(bookmarks AS TEXT) ILIKE with an unescaped user term -- exactly the bug the sibling 04-notes-app course exists to fix, so the batch contradicts itself on the same line of code.
summary: Technically the most impressive delivery in B02. Zod replaces copy-the-allowed-keys pseudo-validation with real strict/partial schemas, and an opt-in metadata endpoint enforces an exact-host allowlist, public-IPv4 DNS checks, connection pinning, redirect refusal and body/time caps -- each layer independently asserted, including a test that DNS resolving after the timeout cannot start a transfer. Also fixed genuinely broken ESM emit paths and Knex TS loading. The SSRF half is senior-level and the course does not staircase into it.
